newsitem.title: USA: Cambior targets 800,000 oz gold output '01.
newsitem.headline: Cambior targets 800,000 oz gold output '01.

text.p: Cambior Inc expects gold production to reach 800,000 ounces per year by 2001, Chief Financial Officer Henry Roy said.
In a presentation to the American Stock Exchange Gold Conference, he reiterated the company expects to produce 550,000 ounces this year.
Cambior's capital spending is expected to total U.S. $160 million this year, up from $114 million in 1996, Roy said.
About $60 million will be spent on Camboir's Gross Rosebel project in Surinam, he said.
